name: tts-foundation
goal: Build the four pure-logic modules VtoT's text-to-speech needs, with four crew teams: device policy, verbatim verbalization, chattiness levels, and the speech queue. Each module is judged by tests its author never sees, and each is cross-tested by a different team member.

tasks.instructions: This decides where Kris's speech goes. The volume numbers were measured on his real headset; do not change them.
tasks.test_instructions: Cover the fallback rule and the session-only speaker permission especially: those are the two the spec cares most about.

tasks.instructions: Work through the contract's worked-example table one row at a time; every row is a test somewhere.
tasks.test_instructions: Include at least one case with a mark inside a word and one with a line break.

tasks.instructions: The levels are cumulative: anything a quieter level says, a louder one also says.
tasks.test_instructions: Test the boundary at each level, not just the extremes.

tasks.instructions: You MUST import the accepted verbalize module rather than repeating its punctuation rules. An alert must never wait behind a long read-back.
tasks.test_instructions: Prove the alert overtakes ordinary speech, and that a speak_fn returning exactly False stops the run and keeps the rest queued.
